subject: EdgeFin access runway & POC success sprint
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Santiago Ruiz <santiago.ruiz@edgefin.com>
Cc: Leah Kim <leah.kim@edgefin.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — EdgeFin POC

Thanks again for the call this morning, Santiago — good discussion and appreciate the clear priorities. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can align the POC timeline:

Summary of priorities:
- Primary goal: validate throughput/cost at 10k monthly inference requests and compare latency with current setup (target p95 < 220ms).
- Data constraints: no customer PII in logs, sandbox dataset only (anonymized).
- Success criteria: p95 latency target, <10% quality delta on our eval suite, and stable API availability for 72h of full-load testing.

Immediate asks from your side:
1) List of 2–3 users to receive SSO invites (ok for SAML/Okta?).
2) IP ranges to add to our allowlist for the trial load test.
3) Any compliance evidence needed early (SOC2 items) — if you want, we can loop in security.

Planned Redwood deliverables (we'll own delivery, assign engineers where needed):
- Provision sandbox project and generate scoped API keys for the trial (ETA: 48 hours).
- Provide IP allowlist endpoints and SSO invite flow doc (ETA: 24–36 hours).
- Shared eval plan with metrics and test harness (ETA: 2 business days).

Can you confirm the SSO/Okta route and share the user emails + CIDR for allowlisting?

Thanks — I’ll get Marissa and Priyom to own the provisioning tasks once you confirm.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

---
From: Santiago Ruiz <santiago.ruiz@edgefin.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Kim <leah.kim@edgefin.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — EdgeFin POC

Thanks Stephanie — recap looks right. Quick answers: 

1) SSO: We use Okta (SAML). Please send the SAML metadata endpoint or the invite template. Users to invite:
   - santiago.ruiz@edgefin.com (myself)
   - leah.kim@edgefin.com (platform lead)
   - m.gonzalez@edgefin.com (engineer)

2) IP allowlist: we'll add the following ranges on our firewall for egress to Redwood (these are from our network team):
   - 18.207.0.0/16
   - 34.210.0.0/16

3) Compliance: we may ask for SOC2 artifact references later but not required for initial sandbox.

Success criteria — tightening them for the POC: 
- p95 latency < 220ms for our typical 512-token prompts at 95th percentile load.
- Throughput: sustain 150 concurrent requests burst for 1 hour without failures.
- Output parity: <8% deviation on our reranking eval.

Can you provision scoped API keys with read-only telemetry and separate keys for stress testing vs. functional evaluation? Also please note: we'll run the stress window next Thursday (9/2) in the afternoon PT.

Santiago
Head of Data Platform, EdgeFin
-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Santiago Ruiz <santiago.ruiz@edgefin.com>, Leah Kim <leah.kim@edgefin.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeFin POC — Access provisioning plan and attachments

Hi Santiago / Leah — looping in the implementation plan and attachables. Per Stephanie’s note I’ll own the provisioning and key handoff, and Priyom will handle the test harness config. Below are concrete steps and what we need from you.

Provisioning steps we will execute (ETA times are business hours):
1) Create sandbox project + two API key sets ("functional" and "stress") — ETA 48 hours.
2) Configure key scopes: functional = inference+embeddings; stress = inference only with rate limits matching your test.
3) SSO SAML setup: we support Okta push — please provide metadata URL or an admin SSO link. We’ll send invite emails once the connector is in place.
4) IP allowlist: we will whitelist your egress CIDRs on our load distribution edge. Please confirm the two ranges Santiago listed.
5) Shared eval harness: Priyom will publish the harness repo and an ingestion guide (ETA 2 business days).

Attachments included (referenced below):
- edgefin-poc-access-matrix.xlsx (mapping of keys, scopes, owners, expiration)
- api-key-generation-steps.pdf (how to rotate keys and fetch telemetry tokens)
- sso-invite-template.txt (text we use when sending SSO invites; you'll see what gets emailed)

IP allowlist endpoints you need on your side (for firewall egress):
- api.edge.redwood.com (A records: 18.207.34.12, 34.210.44.77)
- streaming.edge.redwood.com (A records: 18.207.35.19)

Security notes:
- Keys will be scoped and short-lived by default for the POC (48–72 hour tokens) unless you request longer-lived keys.
- No logs with customer content will be retained; we’ll provide non-content telemetry for performance metrics.

Action items for EdgeFin:
- Confirm the Okta metadata URL or give us an Okta admin email to send the connector invite.
- Confirm CIDRs above.
- Provide the engineering contact for the stress window (name + mobile).

We’ll drop the attachments into the shared Drive folder and send a Drive link shortly.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: edgefin-poc-access-matrix.xlsx; api-key-generation-steps.pdf; sso-invite-template.txt

---
From: Santiago Ruiz <santiago.ruiz@edgefin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Kim <leah.kim@edgefin.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-24 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EdgeFin POC — Access provisioning plan and attachments

Marissa — perfect, thanks for the clear plan. Confirmations below:
- Okta metadata URL: https://edgefin.okta.com/app/exk12345/sso/saml/metadata
- CIDRs: confirmed, network team will allow egress to 18.207.0.0/16 and 34.210.0.0/16.
- Stress window contact: Maria Gonzalez (m.gonzalez@edgefin.com), +1 (650) 555-0211.

We’d prefer 72-hour tokens for the functional keys (makes local debugging easier), and 48-hour tokens for stress keys is fine. Please include a short rotation guide; the api-key-generation-steps.pdf you attached should cover that.

Leah will be the admin for SSO if you need to send an Okta admin invite (leah.kim@edgefin.com).

Looking forward to the Drive link and the HubSpot note for next steps. We’ll plan for the stress run on 2026-09-02 at 14:00 PT.

Thanks,
Santiago

Subject: Re: EdgeFin access runway & POC success sprint — owners and timeline

Thanks all — summary and owners so we’re explicit: 
- Marissa: provisioning + key generation + Drive artifacts (ETA: 48 hours).
- Priyom: publish harness repo + test config + runbook for the stress window (ETA: 2 business days).
- Stephanie: coordinate schedule in HubSpot, confirm stress window, and post the final success criteria to the deal record.

- 2026-08-26: SSO connector test (Leah + Marissa).
- 2026-09-02 14:00 PT: Stress run (Priyom + Maria Gonzalez).

Thanks Santiago — we’ll follow up if anything blocks.
